vault_lines: Oh my, I came from stealing bikes to flying on a G5
meaning:
Kodak uses this line to illustrate his rise to fame, and how he came from nothing to his current state of wealth and popularity. Kodak was raised in a Section 8 household in The Golden Acres Projects, which was so run down it was called “living in hell” by a 1988 lawyer. He also referenced bike thefts in a similar context in his 2013 song “Catch Flight”:

I’ll pull up in a Jag, used to steal bikes

However, Black flips this line to show how he overcame these hardships to reach his current status. A G5 jet is a $36 million plane that is praised for both its efficiency and comfort.. By mentioning this luxurious vehicle, Kodak flexes his rise to stardom and shows off his fame.
